The user has accepted the last suggestion which was shown.
The user has rejected the last suggestion, but accepted at least once in the past.
The user has rejected the last suggestion, and never accepted any suggestion in the past.

enum.int: User did not apply any filters manually after ignoring a Multistep filter suggestion cue.
User manually applied the exact same filters after ignoring a Multistep filter suggestion cue.

enum.name: SuggestionApplicationResult
enum.int: All filters were successfully applied and verified.
Kept for backward compatibility but replaced the by more fine-grained failure states below. Represents any failure case that wasn't abandoned.
The user navigated away, closed the tab, or accepted a new suggestion before the application could be verified.
The navigation to the landing page failed or was to an unsupported scheme.
No filter attributes could be extracted from the landing page.
The number of extracted filters did not match the suggested count.
There was a mismatch in the keys or values of the filters.
